summary: Weighted-average-maturity must weight only over holdings that have a maturity date; holdings with no maturity date must not enter the WAM denominator.
reason: The book command's WAM divided sum(value*days) (accumulated only for dated holdings) by total invested value (all holdings), so any active holding lacking a maturity_date inflated the denominator without contributing to the numerator and silently understated WAM. Mirrors the existing yield calc, which already uses a separate denominator gated on hasYield.
validated_outcome: Added a dayDen accumulator incremented only when hasDays; wam() now returns dayNum/dayDen. WAM of a book containing undated holdings is unchanged by their presence.
